messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED — gpu-prefill-oom detected on cluster gpu-pool-7 at 2024-06-11T03:00:20Z. Auto-pager to @tanvi (oncall). Containers restarting. Severity: P1.

tanvi (oncall): seeing lots of prefill OOMs on nodes in zone-us-west2, reproducing with long-context (~80k token) customer requests. Confirming affected node set.

sam (eng-runtime): logs show CUDA out-of-memory during prefill before generation starts, stacktrace includes kernel alloc at kv_cache.cpp:234. Sending kernel logs.

sam (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: enable aggressive kvcache-eviction and reject >64k token prefill for now on this pool. Pushing config to hotpool.

maria (sre): rolling restart of hotpool nodes already causing thrash; recommend draining new long-context sessions rather than restart. Can we apply backpressure at gateway?

sam (eng-runtime): yes — setting route policy: if prefill_len > 64k route to fallback small-window model; applying now. Config snippet: 
```
route.match: prefill_len > 65536 -> model: redwood-1-small-window
eviction.policy: aggressive-kv
```

tanvi (oncall): ops-bot, please mark nodes in gpu-pool-7 as read-only for scheduling long sessions.

ops-bot: nodes gpu-pool-7-{23,24,25} marked read-only for long-session scheduling.

lee (cs): any customer impact? Which tenants hit this?

tanvi (oncall): two paying tenants saw increased 5xxs for long-input endpoints (tenant_a, tenant_b). Short requests unaffected. Notifying CS.

lee (cs): sending templated status to tenant_a and tenant_b now. Message: "We're experiencing degraded performance for very large context requests; engineers have applied routing controls and are monitoring. No data loss expected"

sam (eng-runtime): telemetry shows error rate down 75% after routing change. KV memory usage on nodes dropped ~40%.

maria (sre): keeping node drains paused. Will observe for 15m then consider rolling reboot of most impacted instances if OOMs reappear.

tanvi (oncall): short term action list: 1) keep routing cap at 64k, 2) aggressive KV eviction ON, 3) mark nodes RO for long sessions, 4) CS notified. Next check-in in 15m.

sam (eng-runtime): opened follow-up issue for runtime: improve prefill allocation check to fail fast instead of attempting huge contiguous allocs. Tagging for priority.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation applied, error rate reducing. Continue monitoring.

lee (cs): tenant_a acknowledged, asked for ETA on full fix. I'll escalate if we need an interim credit.

maria (sre): last check: no new container restarts in past 5m on affected pool. Leaving this thread open for postmortem notes.

tanvi (oncall): thanks all — handing off to oncall rotation in 30m if stable.
